name: Burden of Infrastructure
short_description: Infrastructure is no longer a free by-product of railways and ports. Government-funded Road Works, Rail Works and Harbour Works must supply it, paid for in horses, transportation, merchant marine and wages, and horses come from a new Horse Ranch. Households also buy Housing, a local good supplied by residential buildings that use up infrastructure.
patch_sensitivity_note: Shadows 65 individual vanilla keys (expect 65 harmless Duplicated key lines per launch on 1.15.0), two GUI types, and replaces 16 state-region files and 00_buy_packages.txt as whole files. Three generated file sets must be regenerated after every game patch. Full list and procedure: PATCHING.md and tools/REGENERATE.md.
